answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49848 Country: Bangladesh Title: Mistake is Salah Question: During one Fajr prayer in jamat, I said 3 salams by mistake, 2 salams before the Imam said the 2nd salam and 1 salam after the Imam said his 2nd salam. Now, my question: was my salah valid, if not what should I do? Answer ID: 49848 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 163/146/D=02/1435) Your salah was valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
